subject.title: Feature: support message read action for Telegram

question: What retained-message contract should Telegram `message read` expose, and should it be default-off behind an explicit action/config gate?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing Telegram history changes what retained chat content agents and operators can read, and automation cannot choose the privacy, retention, authorization, or default posture safely.

options.title: Observed-only gated read
options.body: Expose only messages already observed by the running gateway/cache, behind explicit Telegram action/config gates and chat/topic authorization.

options.title: Broader Bot API fetch design
options.body: Design a separate fetch/copy/forward path for specific message IDs or links, with stronger user-visible limits and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Do not add Telegram read
options.body: Keep Telegram without `message read` and direct users toward plugin/archive surfaces if maintainers reject retained-message exposure.

recommendation.title: Observed-only gated read
recommendation.body: Expose only messages already observed by the running gateway/cache, behind explicit Telegram action/config gates and chat/topic authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest issue review and adjacent message-tool read-hint work came from this handle, and the remaining question is product/security direction rather than a narrow code owner decision.
